description: Re-attestation of attest/item2.r11.json (kept as history) after issue #287 extended constraints.dont_use in design/synth/slice.synth.json with the 17 klt 0.9.2 KNOWN_UNSUPPORTED_ASAP7_CELLS masters whose drawn transistor topology differs from the library CDL (11 folded-stack: AND2x4, AND2x6, AOI21x1, AOI22x1, NAND3x2, NOR3x2, OAI21x1, OAI22x1, OR2x6, XNOR2x1, XOR2x1; 6 series-order: A2O1A1O1Ixp25, AOI211xp5, OAI221xp5, SDFLx1, SDFLx2, SDFLx3; all _ASAP7_75t_R), and layout/pnr/regen.py now stages dont_use : true; for the same list in the scratch Liberty so OpenROAD's resizer cannot swap an excluded master back in; the netlist was re-synthesized, the slice re-routed (same request geometry, seed 1) and the column re-assembled. Zero instances of all 27 excluded masters appear in design/netlist/slice_asap7.v and layout/slice_routed.v; the routed-slice LVS r20 record (evidence/item4-lvs/slice_routed.r20.report.json) clears the AOI21x1 fold: device.unmerged_fingers 0 and equal layout/reference device counts, leaving only the klayout-tools#7182 well-tap domain residue. Pinned by sha256 of raw bytes: the assembled column and its inputs. Layout geometry only; DRC and LVS are separate records (spec section 3). ASAP7 is predictive and nothing here is fabricated.

assembled.note: Re-assembled with `python3 layout/assemble_column.py` so the column embeds the re-routed slice stream; `--check` exits 0.

generator.note: The routed slice is reproducible from the committed netlist and the pinned lambdapdk archive; `--check` reproduces it byte-for-byte with the same seed (1), and `--check-input` confirms the tied netlist hashes to the report's provenance.input.content_hash. The netlist itself changed this pass (constraints.dont_use resynthesis, issue #287) and the report was regenerated with it; the report also records the routed DEF and post-route SPEF now persisted beside the GDS/SDF (sta/slice.sta.routed.json times them).

envelope.note: The klt-produced envelope the block manifest cites for item 2; this file is the companion stream inventory.
